notes.title: Snapshot Update Released
notes.notes:
Snapshot now supports complete control of your camera's settings - the value of each setting can now be changed via drop-down boxes.

This update also adds a 'Shoot' button to remotely fire the Shutter Release.

More updates to follow, please get in touch with any feedback or suggestions.
